main_text.p: tale munus oblaturam, quo si potiatur, fore, ut à nullo unquam mortalium vulnerari posser[?]. Bojarus, etsi animo libidinem explere decreverat, virgini tamen pollicetur, do-nec,quam artem esse magicam autumabat, addidicisser, fore ut cum vitâ pudicitiam salvam retineret. Age, igitur, inquit, virgo, verba adhibebo paucis-sima, quorum efficaciam in meo ipsius corpore hoc momento licebit experiri. In ge-nua procumbit, ac parata mo-ri, clarâ voce verba recitat Latina. In manus tuas commendo spiritum meum domine. Quorum cum Bojarus ignarus esset, putans magica, quibus virgo con-traferrum[?] omne munita foret, acinacem evaginavit, ac virginis exporrectam cervicem, hortantis ut confidenter caederet, tanquam certissimum artis experimentum, sumpturus, uno

page.notes: Page number read as "183"; the final digit is printed in a long-s style form and may be a 3 or ȝ. Running head "De Duellis." is in italics. "poffer" is printed with ff for a long s; transcribed as "posser[?]" with plain s per the rules, although the sense suggests "posset". "con-traferrum": the printed hyphen at the line end is kept; the word is probably "contra ferrum" with a missing space. "addidicisser" follows the printed "addidiciffer". Ink blots and specks on the right and in the text are not transcribed. The bottom word "uno" ends the page as a catchword, with a printed dash after it. Printed "vt" was normalised to "ut" (ut à nullo, ut cum, ut confidenter).
